name: South Central Coast & Central Highlands
climate: The coast is drier from about February to August. Heavy rain and typhoons are most likely from September to November. Da Lat stays cool year-round.
days: Da Nang and Hoi An are one trip. Da Lat and the highland towns are another. Do not treat the hills and the sand as a same-day hop.
summary: Da Nang, Hoi An, and My Son on the coast south of Hue, plus Da Lat, Nha Trang, Mui Ne, and the central highland towns.
body: Da Nang airport is the practical gateway. Hoi An is under an hour by road. October can be flooded in Hoi An. Hoang Sa and Truong Sa belong with this region.

Da Lat stays cool year-round. The beaches at Nha Trang and Mui Ne are calmer in the drier months, which differ by town. Kon Tum, Gia Lai, Buon Ma Thuot, Dak Nong, and Mang Den are inland. Most visitors fly into Da Lat or Nha Trang, or take a sleeper from Ho Chi Minh City. Treat the hills and the beaches as different trips.
seoTitle: South Central Coast and Central Highlands
seoDescription: Da Nang, Hoi An, Da Lat, Nha Trang, and the central highlands: how the coast and the hills differ.
